Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing & Communications Intern position at Brussels Marriott Hotel. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media, I am excited about the opportunity to support your marketing team.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my organizational and multitasking skills. I am proficient in MS Excel and PowerPoint, and I have a strong understanding of social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to create engaging content and manage online presence.

I am highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working under pressure. I am eager to contribute to your digital campaigns, assist with reporting, and collaborate with your team. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available to start immediately.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the Marketing & Communications Intern position at Brussels Marriott Hotel. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, content creation, and social media management, I am eager to contribute to your team and support the hotel's marketing efforts.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in managing online presence, creating engaging content, and executing digital campaigns. I am responsible for on-page SEO, keyword research, and publishing content on WordPress sites, which has sharpened my attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks. I am also proficient in using analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush to monitor performance and prepare reports, skills that align with your need for monthly marketing reports and budget monitoring.

My project mirook.com showcases my ability to build and maintain a website, integrate social media, and implement structured data for improved search visibility. This experience has given me a solid understanding of design best practices and the importance of a cohesive online brand presence.

I am highly organized, able to multitask, and comfortable working under pressure. I am a team player with excellent communication skills, and I am eager to collaborate with designers, F&B, and suppliers on marketing materials. I am also familiar with administrative tasks such as invoicing and contract management, and I am proficient in MS Excel and PowerPoint.

I am excited about the opportunity to bring my creativity and technical skills to Brussels Marriott Hotel. I am available to start immediately and am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
